reviews.one_line_contribution: A variance-components audit of per-item counterfactual credit in an LLM agent's experience bank: split leave-one-out item credit into a between-item SD and re-run noise, show that within a class of same-type expert items the between-item SD is indistinguishable from zero, and price in re-runs what a reliable per-item rank, a top-quartile selection, and a pruning decision actually cost.
reviews.closest_prior_work: Data Banzhaf (arxiv:2205.15466, verified via s2cli: AISTATS, 196 citations) is the real threat and the proposal cites it correctly. It already establishes the paper's motivating fact — under a stochastic value function, LOO and Shapley data values are rank-unstable and the observed spread is substantially estimator noise — and proposes the noise-robust semivalue as the fix. What it does not do is separate a between-item variance component from a re-run variance component, report a reliability-versus-sample-count curve, or work on retrieved in-context experience consumed by a multi-step agent; its substrate is retraining on supervised data. SCARV (arxiv:2605.00944, verified) covers stable sample ranking under redundancy, again on static datasets. So the transposition is defensible, but the intellectual core — 'the ranking you are scoring is mostly noise, and here is the sample cost of an honest one' — is Banzhaf's finding plus classical test theory (Spearman-Brown, disattenuation, generalizability theory), applied to a new substrate. On the agent side I verified AttriMem 2607.21106, MemQ 2605.08374, RoMeRL 2608.02508, HiMPO 2606.16285, SF-AMS 2607.22562, TreeMem 2605.04811 (actual title 'Tree-based Credit Assignment for Multi-Agent Memory System') and 2507.04480 (actual title 'Source Attribution in Retrieval-Augmented Generation', PKDD/ECML workshop, not 'Shapley-RAG'); none reports a between-item variance component or a re-run budget, so the gap claim survives. I also verified Data Shapley 1904.02868, FreeShap 2406.04606, amortized Shapley 2305.19998, OddSHAP 2602.01399, and Memory-R2 2605.21768 (2026-05-20, credit assignment for memory-augmented agents, RL-side, not an attribution-variance study). I did not verify 2605.05583, 2602.00428, 2607.06503, 2601.20090, 2110.01307 or 2107.11357 from the proposal's collision check; none is load-bearing for its novelty argument.
reviews.strongest_objection: The headline null is close to being manufactured by the composition it is scored in, and the proposal supplies the arithmetic itself. In C1 the HOLE set still contains two correct same-type expert exemplars, so by the authors' own k-sweep any single item's marginal is bounded near k3 - k2 ~ 4 net; a between-item SD of 8 net among items whose true means are all compressed into a ~4-net band is essentially unreachable unless some expert items are actively harmful, which the design neither plants nor controls. So P1's falsifier is not reachable by the mechanism the falsifier names, and 'tau_E < 5 net' measures a ceiling the design imposed rather than a property of expert experience items. The offered estimator gate does not repair this: the pooled E+W class has a spread planted between classes by P3's 15-net separation, so passing it certifies only that the estimator recovers a between-class difference, never that C1 can express a within-E difference at all. A reviewer will read the headline as 'we compressed the range and then reported that the range is small'. The secondary objection is that the prediction set is one estimate wearing five hats: R(m) = tau^2/(tau^2 + sigma^2/m) is a plug-in identity in tau_S and sigma measured on the very same pairs (P4), winner's-curse retention ~ R(m) is the textbook regression-to-the-mean identity applied to those same 200 halvings (P5), and the pruning-precision curve is a deterministic function of P3's W-E separation and sigma (P6). P4-P6 are calibration checks of an additive-normal model, not independent tests, and the proposal concedes they share one cell; a skeptical AC will count two genuinely open predictions (P2, P3) out of seven.
reviews.what_would_fix_it: Promote C2 (the item as the sole same-type procedure carrier) to the primary composition for P1 rather than the fallback, so that the estimand is not capped at ~4 net before measurement, and re-budget accordingly — C2 currently gets 16 E items at 8 games x 2 seeds, far too thin to carry the headline. Second, add a within-class positive control that C1 and C2 must both pass before any null is scored: expert items planted with a graded quality gradient inside E (truncated procedures, a correct-but-off-object exemplar, verbose-but-correct, partially-correct recovery traces), so a known non-zero within-class tau has to be recovered; the E+W gate cannot substitute for this, because it is a between-class contrast. Third, add an identical-item duplicate pair (the same item entered under two ids) to give an empirical zero-spread reference for the estimator. Fourth, restate P4 and P6 as residuals against the plug-in curve recomputed from the measured tau and sigma with a pre-registered discrepancy bound, so they carry information the components do not already contain, and keep the seed-split versus game-split clause as the one genuinely separate test. Finally, either drop P7(c) or raise backbone 2 to >= 32 paired re-runs per item and state its falsifier explicitly against the attenuation ceiling sqrt(R1 R2) rather than an absolute 0.3, since at 16 paired re-runs the tau_S CI upper bound essentially cannot fall below the stated falsifying threshold.
reviews.missing_baseline: A within-class positive control for the headline cell: expert items planted with a known quality gradient inside E (and/or the same item duplicated under two ids as an empirical zero-spread reference), measured in C1 itself. Every other control in the plan is between-class (E vs W) or between-arm (k3 vs k0, static3), so nothing in the design demonstrates that the C1 estimator can recover a within-class between-item SD when one exists — which is exactly the quantity P1 reports as null. A reviewer will also ask for the naive decision baseline the pruning claim is really competing against: rank items by the free nested-k position credit already in the k-sweep logs, or simply by natural retrieval rank and item length, and show that paired re-runs beat it at equal cost; the proposal places the proxy and slot credit on the reliability-cost curve but never lets a zero-re-run heuristic compete on P6's precision task.

reviews.one_line_contribution: A variance-components measurement of leave-one-out counterfactual credit for individual items in an ALFWorld experience bank: it asks whether same-class items differ in true value by more than re-run noise, and converts the answer into a reliability-versus-re-run curve, a winner's-curse retention rate and a re-run price for a pruning decision.
reviews.closest_prior_work: Data Banzhaf (arxiv:2205.15466, VERIFIED via s2cli paper: AISTATS, 196 citations). It already establishes the mechanism the proposal treats as its discovery — that under a stochastic learning algorithm the LOO and Shapley value of a datum is noise-dominated and its rank unstable, and that the estimator choice, not the data, determines whether a rank survives — and it formalizes rank stability under noise as a safety-margin quantity. Efficient Shapley by amortization (arxiv:2305.19998, VERIFIED, ACL) independently reports that estimated Shapley values are sensitive to random seed. On the measurement side, Signal and Noise (arxiv:2508.13144, VERIFIED, NeurIPS 2025) performs exactly this decomposition — spread across units versus replicate noise, and the reliability consequences for decisions made on it — one level up, at benchmark/model rather than item level. Together these do not pre-empt the proposal: none decomposes item value into a between-item component and a re-run component, none measures a stochastic multi-step agent value function, and none prices a per-item rank in re-runs. But they do remove the conceptual surprise. What is left as new is the object (retrieved experience consumed by an agent) and the numbers, not the idea that per-item value estimates are noise-dominated. That is a real but modest contribution, and it is what caps novelty at 6.
reviews.strongest_objection: The headline null is measured in the one cell where the design makes it nearly automatic. In composition C1 the HOLE set retains two correct same-type expert exemplars, so by the proposal's own arithmetic any helpful item's marginal is bounded by k3 - k2, about 4 net. P1 then claims tau_E < 5 net with a CI upper bound below 8. A between-item SD of true credit cannot exceed the ceiling on the credits themselves, so tau_E < 5 in C1 is close to a consequence of the composition rather than a finding about expert items — an 8-net within-class SD among correct experts could arise only through actively harmful E items, which the design neither plants nor controls. The proposal's estimator gate does not rescue this: the gate is passed by the pooled E+W class, whose spread is planted between classes by harmful items, and it therefore certifies only that the estimator can see between-class spread, never that C1 can express within-class spread among helpful items. Worse, the composition where the item is the sole same-type carrier (C2) — the only cell where a genuine within-class item effect could be expressed — is funded at 16 E items x 8 games x 2 seeds, i.e. 16 paired re-runs per item (per-item SE about 12.7, error variance ~163). tau_E is simply not estimable there. So the paper as budgeted can produce its headline null only in the cell that cannot falsify it, and cannot produce it in the cell that could. A second, compounding objection: even taken at face value, 'expert ALFWorld trajectories of the same task type are interchangeable' is close to a property of the bank — Measurement C already shows a fixed three-exemplar static prompt recovers +12.4 of the ~+27 net k3 gain, i.e. most same-type item content is the type procedure — so the null generalizes to scorer papers only weakly, and the interesting positive result (tau_S >= 12 for self-written items) sits in the smaller arm at 2 seeds.
reviews.what_would_fix_it: Three changes, in order of importance. (1) Move the headline to a composition that can express within-class spread and fund it: make C2 (item as sole same-type carrier) the decision cell at 4 seeds and enough games to reach ~64 paired re-runs per item for 40 E items, and demote C1 to the bounding arm. (2) Add a within-class graded-quality positive control among *helpful* items — expert trajectories degraded by known, calibrated amounts (truncated at the penultimate procedure step, correct procedure with a wrong receptacle, verbose paraphrase) planted at a designed within-E spread — and require the estimator to recover that known tau before any null is scored. The current gate, which uses the between-class E+W separation, does not test the quantity P1 asserts. (3) Score P4 and P6 as residuals against the plug-in curves computed from the measured tau and sigma, with a pre-registered discrepancy bound, rather than as bands that are already implied by P1/P2/P3; and either raise backbone 2 to at least 32 paired re-runs per item or drop P7(b) and state P7(c)'s falsifier relative to the measured attenuation ceiling sqrt(R1 R2) instead of an absolute 0.3.
reviews.missing_baseline: A noise-robust multi-coalition estimator on the same reliability-versus-cost axis as fixed-composition LOO. The proposal's own closest prior work (Data Banzhaf, 2205.15466) exists precisely because LOO is the least noise-robust semivalue and the Banzhaf value the robust one; here the Banzhaf-style two-coalition average appears only inside the small additivity cell (768 episodes, class-level test), while every headline curve — reliability R(m), split-half Spearman, winner's-curse retention, pruning precision — is computed for single-composition LOO alone. A reviewer will demand the same curves for a two-or-more-coalition estimator at matched LLM-call budget: if between-item signal appears under randomized co-retrieved sets but not under fixed-composition LOO, the paper's headline is 'LOO in one composition has no signal', not 'there is no item to credit', and the cited prior work predicts exactly that outcome. Secondary omission: a same-item duplicate arm (two surface variants of the identical trajectory) to establish the surface-noise floor of tau, which would separate content variance from formatting variance in tau_S.

reviews.one_line_contribution: A variance-components audit of per-item counterfactual credit in an ALFWorld experience bank: it estimates how much of the spread in leave-one-out item scores is real between-item signal versus re-run noise, separately for expert, self-written and planted-wrong items, and converts that decomposition into a reliability-versus-re-run curve, a winner's-curse retention rate and a re-run budget at which pruning beats random.
reviews.closest_prior_work: Data Banzhaf (arxiv:2205.15466, VERIFIED via s2cli paper: AISTATS, 196 citations) is the strongest threat: it already establishes that under a stochastic learning algorithm LOO and Shapley data values are dominated by run-to-run noise and rank unstably, and proposes the noise-robust semivalue. Its abstract's claim -- 'when the underlying ML algorithm is stochastic, the Banzhaf value ... robustly differentiate[s] data quality' -- is the same measurement insight one level up. It does not pre-empt the proposal: its noise is retraining stochasticity over supervised training data, it reports rank stability rather than a between-item variance component, and it never gives a re-run count for a target reliability. Two nearer-in-domain works, both VERIFIED: CUE-R (arxiv:2604.05467, cit 2) already does per-evidence-item REMOVE/REPLACE interventions to measure operational utility, but in single-shot RAG and with no variance decomposition or repeat-measurement analysis; and Source Attribution in RAG (arxiv:2507.04480, PKDD/ECML workshops, cit 7) already trades attribution fidelity against LLM-call cost for document-level SHAP, though its estimator error is coalition sampling on a fixed value function, not re-run noise of a stochastic agent. Also verified and cited correctly: 1904.02868, 2406.04606, 2305.19998 (which itself notes Shapley estimates are seed-sensitive), 2605.04811, 2606.16285, 2608.02508, 2607.22562, 2605.08374, 2607.21106. arxiv:2605.00944 (SCARV) could not be resolved by `s2cli.py paper` but was returned by an S2 keyword search with matching title, so I treat it as verified; nothing else in the proposal's novelty argument failed verification. Net: the question is under-asked in the agent-memory literature, but the machinery (variance components, Spearman-Brown, disattenuation, split-half) is entirely classical, so novelty rests on the domain, not the method.
reviews.strongest_objection: The headline null is close to forced by the chosen composition, and the proposal's own numbers say so. In C1 the HOLE set retains two correct same-type expert exemplars, so by the measured k-sweep any single helpful item's marginal is bounded by k3 - k2 ~ 4 net. If the entire attainable credit range for correct expert items is about 4 net, a between-item SD below 5 net is arithmetic, not a finding: P1 cannot fail except through actively harmful expert items, which the design neither plants nor controls. The pre-registered estimator gate does not repair this, because it certifies only that the estimator recovers the between-class E-vs-W spread -- a spread manufactured by planting harmful items -- and never that C1 can express within-class differences among helpful ones. A second, independent version of the same objection: the estimand is the item main effect averaged over a fixed 16-game panel, which deliberately averages out the item-by-game matching component, yet the group's own Measurement C shows k3 - static3 = +17.2 net, i.e. retrieval buys a great deal over three fixed exemplars -- evidence that which item meets which game matters a lot. Reporting 'no item-level signal' from a design that averages away the one component known to be large invites the reading that the null is an artifact of the estimand. The interlocking makes this worse rather than better: the entailment check flags P1, P4 and P6 as near-entailed, and P4/P5/P6 are plug-in functions of tau_S, sigma and the W-E separation computed on the same 200 halvings of the same cell, so seven predictions carry roughly two free parameters plus one class separation. P7(c) states no falsifier and tests a 0.3 threshold with SE 0.16 at 40 items.
reviews.what_would_fix_it: (1) Move P1's confirmatory scoring to C2, where the item is the sole same-type procedure carrier and the credit range is not capped at ~4 net; report C1 as the natural-composition secondary. (2) Add a within-class positive control with a known non-zero tau: plant a graded-quality ladder of expert items (full, truncated-at-the-key-step, verbose-but-correct, partially-wrong) so the estimator must recover a within-E spread it was built to detect before any within-E null is scored; a between-class E+W gate cannot license a within-class null. (3) Fit item, game and item-by-game as three variance components on the shared panel and report the matching component explicitly, rather than inferring it only from the seed-split-versus-game-split contrast; state the headline as a decomposition ('item main effect is X% of the retrieval residual over static3, matching is Y%') tied to the measured +17.2 net, which turns a possibly-forced null into a positive number. (4) De-interlock P4-P6: score them as residuals against the plug-in curve computed from the measured tau and sigma, with pre-registered discrepancy bounds, exactly as the entailment check suggests. (5) Raise backbone 2 to >= 32 paired re-runs per item and give P7(c) an explicit falsifier stated relative to the attenuation ceiling sqrt(R1*R2), not an absolute 0.3. With (1)+(2)+(3) this becomes a defensible borderline-to-accept measurement paper; as written the headline is not testable in the arm that carries it.
reviews.missing_baseline: A within-class graded-degradation positive control for expert items -- expert trajectories degraded along a known quality ladder (step truncation, verbosity padding, partially-corrupted procedure) and planted into C1/C2 so a known non-zero within-E tau must be recovered before tau_E ~ 0 is reported. Every control in the plan (pooled E+W gate, W-E separation, k3-vs-k0 backbone gates) is between-class; none establishes that the design can express within-class spread among helpful items, which is precisely what P1 claims to bound. Secondarily missing: a natural-retrieval (uncontrolled-panel) arm, since all estimates come from a retrieval-forced panel that is not the distribution any deployed scorer operates on, and the token-matched replacement arm bounds composition rather than retrieval frequency.
reviews.preprint_collision: No verified collision. The proposal's own check is one of the better ones I have seen in this round: it reports five queries with the channel that answered each, gives IDs for what came back, distinguishes verified from returned (it states that its 'Banzhaf' query did not return Data Banzhaf and that the id was confirmed separately with the paper command), and reports an empty result as empty rather than as evidence. Its gap is that it never queries the method's actual home vocabulary -- classical psychometrics: generalizability theory, variance components, Spearman-Brown, disattenuation -- which is where a collision for a reliability-of-item-value paper would live. My searches, all answered by channel (a), the s2cli command querying S2+HF; WebSearch was unavailable in this session and was not used: (i) 'between-item variance decomposition of counterfactual credit for retrieved memory items in LLM agents' --recent returned 2607.25659, 2607.21106, 2605.08374, 2603.21563, 2603.04549, 2606.24595 -- all scorers or credit-propagation methods, none measuring the variance of the score itself; (ii) 'how many repeated runs are needed for a stable per-item value rank split-half reliability of data valuation estimates' --recent returned 2602.07150 (On Randomness in Agentic Evals, VERIFIED, cit 7), 2603.29231, 2512.07795, 2511.19794, 2604.12843 (IRT for benchmark calibration), 2602.00521 (IRT reliability of LLM judges) -- the closest family: re-run variance and psychometric reliability are being applied to agent and judge evaluation at the arm level, but none to per-item memory credit, so this is a live and encroaching neighbourhood rather than a collision; (iii) 'Data Banzhaf noise-robust data valuation ranking stability under stochastic training' returned SCARV 2605.00944 and otherwise noise-robustness papers unrelated to data valuation, reproducing the proposal's reported miss; (iv) 'leave-one-out removal of individual in-context demonstrations variance of estimated example utility' returned 2604.05467 (CUE-R), 2406.04606, 2309.17310, 2605.26350 (When Correct Demonstrations Hurt) -- CUE-R is the nearest intervention-based per-item measurement and reports no variance components; (v) 'winner's curse regression to the mean when selecting top-scored examples under noisy evaluation' --recent returned 2607.08522, 2508.13144 (Signal and Noise), 2606.27997 -- selection-under-noise at the benchmark level, not the item level; (vi) 'generalizability theory variance components reliability of influence estimates signal-to-noise ratio of instance attribution scores' returned nothing on data valuation at all; (vii) 'do individual memory items differ in utility variance components ...' --recent and (viii) 'how many rollouts per memory item are needed before pruning beats random pruning ...' --recent returned no relevant hit. Two searches were empty of anything on the mechanism and are reported as empty. Recency is genuinely covered by (i), (ii), (v), (vii), (viii), all --recent, so I score novelty as real but modest -- the method is off-the-shelf psychometrics and the adjacent literature (2602.07150, 2604.12843, 2602.00521) is already carrying it into LLM evaluation.
